name: preset:red_rock_mesa
label: Red-rock canyon / mesa
description: Red dirt floors with red sand and pale tan patches under dark red sandstone mesas, cliff bands on every steep face.

arches.$comment: Arches (ADR 0074 B8): openings carved through narrow fins of the bedded sandstone the cut-back leaves (Arches NP): density sites per km² (one chance per 32 m square), span across the fin, rise of its crown over the floor, lintel the rock left above (each [min, max] m), fin the thickest fin cut through (m); overhangs: a scarp's site (low on one side) cut as an overhang from its low side. Absent or density 0: none.

fins.$comment: The erosion's fin rule (0.52.66): where the cut-back fronts from drainage lines on either side come within approach m of meeting, or have met by at most overrun m, a fin width m wide stands on the crest between them, so the arches find fins.
